$comment: Controlled vocabulary for the optional `archive_type` field: the kind of institution named in `archive` (the holder), not the kind of collection. `name` is the only value allowed in data/collections.json. A value is recorded only when the institution's own name makes the type unambiguous; joint, renamed, or unclear holders are left without one. See DATA_DICTIONARY.md §2 and METHODOLOGY.md §4.

terms.name: national archive or library
terms.definition: A national archive, library, or sound archive, as its name says (e.g. "National Archives of …", "Arquivo Nacional …", "Fonoteca Nacional …", "State Archives of …").

terms.name: university or research institute
terms.definition: A university, college, or conservatoire, or a unit of one; an academy of sciences or one of its institutes; or an institute or centre whose name describes it as doing research or studies in a discipline.

terms.name: museum
terms.definition: A museum, or a department or archive of a museum.

terms.name: community or independent project
terms.definition: A collective, people's or community archive, or other independent project not part of a larger institution.

terms.name: broadcaster
terms.definition: A radio or television broadcaster, or a broadcasting archive.

terms.name: intergovernmental body
terms.definition: An organisation of states (e.g. UNESCO, the African Union) or one of its centres or lists.

terms.name: language archive
terms.definition: An archive whose name describes it as dedicated to language documentation.

terms.name: foundation or nonprofit
terms.definition: A foundation, association, society, registered association (e.V.), or other nonprofit organisation, as its name says.

terms.name: government agency
terms.definition: A ministry, board, or other government body that is not a national archive or library.
